<!-- Starting template: adapt prompts and sections to the project and change; remove anything irrelevant. -->

## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if useful.

## Validation

State the checks or manual scenarios actually run and their results. State what was skipped or remains unverified; source inspection alone does not establish runtime correctness.

## Compatibility

State any public API, behavior, platform, toolchain, or configuration impact. Include migration instructions for breaking changes and use `!` in the PR title. Write “No compatibility impact” when applicable.
